# cb:b547

> Folding, renaming, or relocating a repo orphans every inbound document:/code: artifact that other graphs cite into it: the artifact enum (cb:b066) has no rebind operation - cb:b545 records the same missing-rebind gap even for commits - so the pointers silently dangle the moment the path moves. A repo move is therefore not done until its inbound artifacts resolve again. Before decommissioning, sweep every dependent graph for the old path; repoint each typed artifact with a corrective evidence append (mix cb.evidence) to the new location, leaving the original entry as dated history (claims and detail prose are immutable and stay as written). The okf-fold (cb:b546) is the worked example: deleting amieval/knowledge left four cb: evidence artifacts (cb:b518/b540/b543/b544) pointing at document:../knowledge/..., caught only in the post-fold audit.
